title: feat(spec,ui)!: every grid that renders editable selects a cell first, and object-grid singleClickEdit is retired

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化:所有「可编辑」的表格(对象视图自己画的表格、页面里放的 object-grid 表格,和列表页一样)都改成「先选中、再编辑」:单击选中单元格,双击、回车、F2 或直接打字进入编辑,改完一格立刻保存;「全部保存 / 全部取消」那条保存栏不再出现。不可编辑的表格不变,单击仍然打开记录。元数据里的 `singleClickEdit`(单击即编辑)作废:写了会报错并提示删掉,`os migrate meta` 能自动删除。
- 为什么:按您的裁定 A「统一新编辑方式」。新方式里单击是「选中」,`singleClickEdit` 已经没有可切换的东西,按 ADR-0049「要么执行、要么删除」退役;`keyboardNavigation` 的说明也改成实际行为(可编辑表格上方向键导航始终开启)。
- 最坏情况:有人在页面元数据里写了 `singleClickEdit`,升级后该页面校验失败,需要删掉这个键(提示里写明了怎么做,迁移工具可自动删);或者某张可编辑表格的使用者习惯了单击就编辑,现在要多一次双击。本仓、hotcrm、gallery 中没有任何地方写过这个键。
- 需要您做的:无(L2 由席位在最终提交上做)。

## What changes

The ruling A on #36270 (record 7076617499): one editing model. Every grid that renders editable uses the list page's select-first cell model, and the key that only made sense in the old model is retired.

- **`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`** (the one behaviour hunk): `hostCellSelection = cellSelectionProp ?? inlineEditable`. Absent a host's `cellSelection`, a grid that renders editable (`editable` AND the object's inline-edit verdict AND the reader's `update` grant) is select-first; a read-only grid keeps click-to-open. A host's `true` (`ListView`, the related tab) or `false` still wins. The data table is handed `singleClickEdit: true` unconditionally: it is inert under select-first, and it is the staged model's old default for a host that passes `false`.
- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `ComponentPropsMap['object-grid'].singleClickEdit` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone; D2 conversion `object-grid-single-click-edit-removed` (strip, whatever the value; order 83), D3 `object-grid-single-click-edit-retired`, `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` row `ui/ObjectGridProps:singleClickEdit`, a `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 123), ledger `page.json` regions note [122] plus the narrowed [43]. `keyboardNavigation`'s describe narrows to what is enforced: always on for a grid that renders editable, `true` turns it on for a read-only grid.
- **`@object-ui/types`**: `ObjectGridSchema.singleClickEdit?: never` with a `retirementTombstone()` zod twin; the `object-view` `table` slot inherits it (`TABLE_INHERITED_TOMBSTONES`, as `defaultSort`). `DataTableSchema.singleClickEdit` (host-paired) is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-view`**: `table.singleClickEdit` leaves `OBJECT_VIEW_TABLE_RELAY_KEYS`. The earlier host-level `cellSelection` spread is gone: `ObjectGrid`'s default covers the object-view grid, authored nodes and react pages in one place.
- **`object-grid` inputs, `sdui.manifest.json`, `content/docs/ui/components/*`**: the `singleClickEdit` input is gone and the `editable` / `keyboardNavigation` descriptions say what the grid does. Docs and READMEs (`plugin-grid.mdx`, `plugin-view.mdx`, both packages' READMEs) describe select-first everywhere and the staged model as a host's `cellSelection={false}`.
- BREAKING changeset `.changeset/36270-object-grid-single-click-edit-retired.md` (`@objectstack/spec` minor plus the three ui packages), with the FROM → TO table and `<!-- adr-0087: registered … -->`.

## The card's Done-when: the five grid families

- **The object-view grid** (Studio view preview, a page placing an `object-view`) and **the authored `object-grid` node**: changed here. Pinned by `ObjectView.perCellSave-36270.test.tsx` and `authoredGridPerCellSave-36270.test.tsx`, with the ablation below.
- **The related tab**: already select-first. `RelatedList.tsx` passes `cellSelection: true`, pinned by `RelatedList.tab-35892.test.tsx`; unchanged.
- **The record picker and the designer grids** (`RecordPickerDialog`, `ObjectManager`, `FieldDesigner`): they render `ObjectGrid` without `editable`, so they are read-only and unchanged.
- **Dashboard tables**: they are `data-table` / `object-data-table` nodes, not `ObjectGrid`, and have no save path. The card's dashboard-table pin therefore has no subject: there is no editable dashboard grid to pin. A bare `data-table` that a host hands `editable` still stages edits and draws its bar; that is the table primitive, which no in-repo grid host reaches.
- So every grid that renders editable through `ObjectGrid` selects a cell first, and no in-repo host passes `cellSelection={false}`.
- **The card's second Read-first question** (a child list inside a parent form saved together, #35590): no in-repo host draws such a list through an editable `ObjectGrid`. The form's line items are the `GridField` widget, which this PR does not touch, and no in-repo host passes `cellSelection={false}` or its own `onBatchSave`. So no saved-together list loses its staging here.
- **A React host's `onBatchSave`**: a host that passes `onBatchSave` alone on an editable `ObjectGrid` now has it bypassed (each cell writes through `onRowSave` or the grid's own `dataSource.update`). No in-repo host passes it. The changeset carries a FROM → TO row for it and `ObjectGridComponentProps.onBatchSave` is marked `@deprecated`.

## Tests

- New: `packages/spec/src/ui/object-grid-single-click-edit.pin.test.ts` (tombstone at both channels for `true` / `false`, `editable` control, the narrowed describe, the conversion's delete and its controls, the step-18 wiring), `object-grid-single-click-edit-retirement.test.ts` (tree-scoped absence, `repo` project), `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/authoredGridPerCellSave-36270.test.tsx` (an authored editable node saves one cell with no Save All; read-only and host-`false` controls), and the earlier `ObjectView.perCellSave-36270.test.tsx`.
- Migrated to the enforced contract: `ObjectGrid.keyboardNavigation-11068.test.tsx` (editable grids read the select-first pattern and `false` no longer turns it off; a host `cellSelection={false}` control keeps the old roving-focus reading), `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`, `rowContextMenu-28434.test.tsx`, the types slot/round-6 tests, the ObjectView relay test.
- 25 plugin-grid inline-edit files that pin the staged path now pass `cellSelection={false}` and no longer author `singleClickEdit`; two that passed `cellSelection={x || undefined}` pass `cellSelection={x}` (under the new default `undefined` means select-first).
- `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` joins the new conversion.

## Acceptance notes

- Select-first only where a grid renders editable, per the ruling; read-only grids keep click-to-open (pinned by the controls above).
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: the house spelling for a retirement; the seat re-amended the claim to it (7077058264).
- Census of authored `singleClickEdit` in this repository's examples, hotcrm and gallery: zero, so the conversion is for stored rows and outside authors.
- `check-governed-merges --pr 36357`: NOT governed (0 of 60 paths), 1,355 changed lines, under the 3,000 human-merge threshold.
- With #36332 (seat delta review 7077725274): once both land, a touch never edits in place on any editable grid. The one exception is a host that passes `cellSelection={false}`, which keeps the staged click-to-edit, so there a touch edits in place. Whichever of the two lands second re-runs overlap-check against the other's head.
- #35827 (retire `onBatchSave`) is unblocked by this: no authored or ObjectView grid reaches the batch save any more; only a host's explicit `cellSelection={false}` does.

## Verification

Two-minute check: author `{ "type": "object-grid", "properties": { "objectName": "<any>", "editable": true } }` on a page; click a cell (it is selected, nothing opens), press Enter, type, press Enter: the value saves at once and no "Save All" bar appears. Add `"singleClickEdit": true`: the page refuses it with the prescription.

Files to read first, by risk: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (two hunks), `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/18/object-grid-single-click-edit-removed.ts`, `ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`.
